elimination.headline: Eliminated
elimination.helper: You can spectate now or view results.

actionOutcome.VIEW_RESULTS: Open results now to review final placement and leaderboard outcome.
actionOutcome.VIEW_LEADERBOARD: Open results now with leaderboard rows focused by placement.
actionOutcome.SPECTATE: Enter spectator mode and keep watching current match.

postMatch.guidance: Choose your next step. You can rematch now or leave the room.
postMatch.blockedGuidance: Acknowledge leaderboard sync warning first. Rematch and routing unlock immediately after acknowledgement.

actionOutcome.REPLAY_MATCH: Start rematch ready-check in same lobby and respawn all players when countdown begins.
actionOutcome.BACK_TO_LOBBY: Return to lobby roster without exiting current room.
actionOutcome.EXIT_TO_MENU: Leave room and clear rematch intent.

acceptanceChecks.assertion: Elimination contract always exposes explicit helper copy and deterministic CTA outcome copy.
Manual elimination CTA selection cancels inactivity auto-route and preserves selected route.
Post-match rematch/lobby/menu actions include explicit outcome guidance and blocked failure guidance.
